items.caption: This seal-style rendering shows 汽 as a joined form. The Shuowen analysis identifies 水 as the meaning element and 气 as the sound element.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 汽, with a water element on the left and 气 on the right.
items.selection_reason: It provides a visible illustration of the dictionary-reported seal form and the parts in the supported phonosemantic analysis; it is a modern redraw, not an ancient specimen.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, not an artifact image. No earlier graphic sequence or date for this form is established.
